fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.beauty: An elegant humanoid plant, this beautiful beast seems to shrug off all attacks by parrying them. However, it can only parry one attack at once.
Blitz, Whom does not retreat. An elemental infused with lightning. It leaps, dealing damage around itself and then dashes backwards or strafes.
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.blosso: flower. zombie. symbiosis. It appears in jungles, the zombie part as you would expect, and the bud shoots an area of slowing sap to close the gap.
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.canary: A Metallic chimera that appears in very deep caves. It will circle the player and try to bash them with their mask. When it strikes, you will feel an aftershock on your health. It's sweeping tail attacks are weak against people, but can be turned around on themselves!
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.cannon: A Crab, armed with artillery. It appears in the end, hovering over players and bobbing down to strike. It is weak, but tough. It's underside is a weak point.
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.coat_o: A strange creature native to swamps. It only moves cardinally, and can only fire it's projectiles along it's movement paths. Move erratically to avoid the ire.
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.detrit: A festering zombie found in deep caves. When struck or threatened, it will split into crude imitations of itself recusively, until the threat is neutralized.
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.dreamw: A Creature of the Outer End, it behaves similarly to a spider, but once it's abdomen becomes ruptured, it will release more spiders and become riled!
A distant relative of the creeper, found in the end. When it detonates, it releases a cloud of sedating spores, putting you to sleep! Not where you want to be in a dangerous place...
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.fend.d: A creature created from floweing essence that appears in sunflower fields and other flowery biomes. It has several variants that combat differently, but they never seem to turn on each other.
Appearing in Nether Wastes, these impish creatures kick blocks at the player while approaching to attack in close range. Sometimes, they harbor a skeletal friend.
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.machin: Electrum automatons which attack by kicking you. If you are too far, they can wind up a rush kick that sends them flying.
A zombie with an exposed, swollen brain. Simple to enrage, these abberations prefer warmer climates to prevent brain freeze.
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.minedf: A cosmic jellyfish, thinking of nothing. Floats around, floats to you if it spots you. It isn't very physically threatning, but it can disorient you with psychic blasts, rotating your camera.
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.mockin: Appears on mountains, firing pinions at foes and circling around. Strangely, it seems very humanoid.
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.nothin: Why do you want to know about nothing? How has nothing been quantifed? It will torment you. Do not think. Only fight.
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.pathog: Supports undead monsters by infusing them with healing energy that can actually repair dead tissue! They can hide within monsters, forcing you to kill them before you can find it!
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.saint_: A living constellation, Ursa Major, dound in the Aether. Spews smaller stars from it's abdomen which gravitate to you. If these stars collide with itself, something special may happen...
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.sinist: A mass of silver tarnish, holding a mirror that reflects damage. To slay it, hit the mass behind the mirror!
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.staine: A glass bird that appears in deserts. It roosts above prey, swooping down to trike before swiftly rebounding to safety. It is exceedingly frail, and one strike will send it tumbling down to earth.
fieldguide.entity.creaturefeature.vertig: A sickened horned mammal found in yagroot swamps. It is aggressive, charging at players and spitting vile poison secretions at them like a llama.
